title: Đề Dự Đoán 13 — House and Architecture

parts.instructions: You are a new member of the club. Fill in the form. Write in sentences. Use 20-30 words.
You are communicating with other members of the club in the chat room. Reply to their questions. Write in sentences. Use 30-40 words per answer.

chatMessages.messageText: Recently I have been spending time working from home but my neighbors make so much noise that irritates me. What should I do?
Many people want to stay in old places with historical imprints, but there are also people who like to stay in modern places. Which style do you prefer? Why?
Houses should be designed in accordance with future environmental protection. Your opinion?

parts.instructions: You are a member of the club. Read the notice from the club president/manager and write the requested emails.
parts.managerNotice:
" The cost of staying in the old apartment building is too high and these buildings also take up a lot of space. Therefore, the government has the proposal to knock down the old buildings and build more modern blocks. Give your opinion?"
Q1: Write an email to your friend, who is also a member of our club. Tell your friend what suggestions you will make and why. Write about 50 words.
Q2: Write an email to the manager of the club. Write about your ideas and what you think about the situation. Write about 120-150 words.

tasks.prompt: Write an email to your friend who is also a member of House and Architecture. Express your thoughts and feelings about the announcement and suggest what you both should do.

Write an email to the president/manager of House and Architecture. Give your detailed feedback, propose constructive solutions for the initiative, and explain why your suggestions would benefit the club.
